name: Vektor 7.5-inch
datum: origin = centre of the stack; +X right, +Y front, +Z up; Z = 0 underside of the lower skin

printed.title: Tail trident (VTX antenna, two RX antennas, XT60)
printed.hardware: the VTX antenna's SMA nut; a zip tie over the XT60
printed.notes: Print it standing, as it sits on the quad (the bridge over the receiver spans 28 mm), 4 perimeters, 30 % infill. Slide the sleeves over the rear standoffs before the battery plate goes on. Push each receiver antenna's base into a tube.

printed.title: Camera pod, 19 mm
printed.hardware: the camera's two M2 side screws
printed.notes: Slide it over the front standoffs before the battery plate goes on; set the tilt, tighten the side screws.

printed.title: Side fairing, right
printed.notes: Print it upside down; the slits' 3 mm tops bridge cleanly. Snap it on from outside after the sleeves of the camera pod and the trident.

printed.title: Side fairing, left
printed.notes: Print it upside down; the slits' 3 mm tops bridge cleanly. Snap it on from outside after the sleeves of the camera pod and the trident.

printed.title: Motor guard
printed.notes: Stretch it over the arm's tip, motor off: one lip over the upper pad, one under the lower ring.

printed.title: Foot
printed.hardware: the six body bolts, 5 mm longer

printed.title: GPS tray
printed.hardware: 4x M3x8 into nylocs under the plate; foam tape under the module

printed.title: Action-camera mount
printed.notes: Takes the GPS tray's four holes: fit one or the other.

printed.title: Wire grommet
printed.notes: Squeeze it into the slot from above until the lip clicks under the skin; then feed the wires through.
